note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Ground surface (g(23), ground_up) at 1:1 is soft and low-contrast; the original's cracked ridge network reads as faint diffuse shading, and the fine grain looks like uniform stamped noise rather than real stone detail.
flags.fix: Keep the ridge/crack edges crisp at 1:1 (less blur in the colormatch or lab-inject step) and make the grain amplitude vary with the underlying shading instead of a uniform overlay. Re-check the 1:1 centre crop.

flags.problem: The barrel cylinder (upper half) shows heavy horizontal brushed-metal streaks at 1:1 that the original smooth grey barrel does not have, so the injected lab grain changes the material; the bottom blue-riveted panel is fine.
flags.fix: Reduce lab-inject amplitude on the smooth barrel region, or restrict grain to the panel area, so the barrel stays a smooth painted metal. Keep the hard cutout edges as they are.
